items.informal_name: Alternating Map Vanishes on Double Updates with Equal Values
items.informal_description:
For an alternating map $ f $, if $ i 
eq j $, then applying $ f $ to a function that has been updated at both indices $ i $ and $ j $ to have the same value $ m $ results in zero. Formally, $ f(	ext{update}(	ext{update}(v, i, m), j, m)) = 0 $.

items.informal_name: Alternating Map Zero on Duplicate Entry
items.informal_description: Let $ f $ be an alternating map from $ \iota \to M $ to $ N $ over a semiring $ R $. For any distinct indices $ i,j \in \iota $ and function $ v : \iota \to M $, it holds that $ f(v[i := v(j)]) = 0 $, where $ v[i := v(j)] $ denotes the function obtained by replacing the value at index $ i $ with $ v(j) $.

items.informal_name: Sign Change for Insertion in Alternating Maps: $(-1)^p$ Factor
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup N]
  [inst_3 : Module R M] [inst_4 : Module R N] {n : ℕ} (f : M [⋀^Fin (n + 1)]→ₗ[R] N) (p : Fin (n + 1)) (x : M)
  (v : Fin n → M), (-1) ^ ↑p • f (p.insertNth x v) = f (Matrix.vecCons x v)
items.informal_description: For any alternating multilinear map $ f : M^{n+1} \to N $ over a semiring $ R $, any index $ p \in \text{Fin}(n+1) $, element $ x \in M $, and vector $ v : \text{Fin}(n) \to M $, the value of $ f $ evaluated at the vector obtained by inserting $ x $ at position $ p $ in $ v $ is equal to $ (-1)^p $ times $ f $ evaluated at the vector with $ x $ prepended to $ v $.

items.informal_description: For an alternating map $ f $ from the exterior power $ \bigwedge^{n+1} M $ to $ N $, inserting an element $ x \in M $ at position $ p \in \mathrm{Fin}(n+1) $ into a vector $ v : \mathrm{Fin}(n) \to M $ results in the identity $ f(\mathrm{insertNth}_p(x, v)) = (-1)^{p} \cdot f(\mathrm{vecCons}(x, v)) $, where $ \mathrm{vecCons}(x, v) $ denotes the vector formed by prepending $ x $ to $ v $.

items.informal_name: Alternating Map Cancellation for Equal Inputs
items.informal_description: For an alternating map $ f $ from the exterior power of an $ R $-module $ M $ to another $ R $-module $ N $, if two inputs $ v_i $ and $ v_j $ (with $ i \neq j $) of a function $ v : \mathrm{Fin}(n+1) \to M $ are equal, then the signed sum $ (-1)^i \cdot f(v^{(i)}) + (-1)^j \cdot f(v^{(j)}) $ equals zero, where $ v^{(k)} $ denotes the function obtained by removing the $ k $-th element from $ v $.
